name: codex-thread-organizer
description: Create linked, proposal-only Notion reports for Codex task and ChatGPT web organization.

interface.longDescription: In Codex Desktop, read Codex or ChatGPT conversation bodies, reason across an evidence corpus, and write linked, dated Notion proposals. It never renames chats or changes Projects.
defaultPrompt: Use the explicitly named local Codex or ChatGPT-web route to write a linked Notion proposal report.
